# Exxon Valdez: Production
model = "Exxon Valdez"
length_m = 301.0
beam_m = 51.0
lbr = length_m / beam_m
print(f"Length-to-beam ratio: {lbr:.2f}:1")  # -> 5.90:1
print("specs: Length: 301 m; Beam: 51 m; Draft: 19.8 m; Deadweight: 214,861 t; Cargo capacity: 1.48 million barrels; Engines: 1 × Sulzer 8RND90M diesel; Service speed: 16.25 knots")
print("OK: JAH-EVAL-000018 verified")
demo.note: Demonstration recomputes the derived statistic from the record's own numbers.

standards: Classification society rules (e.g. Lloyd's Register, DNV)
description: Operators of the Exxon Valdez value its oil tanker capabilities: 1989 spill: ~11 million gallons in Prince William Sound Deployed across its 1986–2012 service life by fleets chosen for the mission it performs.
key_points: 1989 spill: ~11 million gallons in Prince William Sound
Led to the Oil Pollution Act of 1990
Forced the global phase-out of single-hull tankers
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
